name: CoRA_math_reasoning_benchmark_DPO_hints
description: A dataset of math reasoning problems with DPO-style hint annotations designed to evaluate models' mathematical problem solving and stepwise reasoning under preference-based learning. It measures a model's ability to produce correct final answers and coherent intermediate reasoning when provided with hints. The benchmark is intended for fine-tuning and evaluating models on structured math reasoning tasks.
reputation: A recent, specialized dataset aimed at researchers working on math reasoning and preference-based fine-tuning; modest community adoption so far.
